translation.title: Felbinac Plaster
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner and apply 1 plaster to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, to its ingredients, or to other felbinac preparations, if you have or have had asthma triggered by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, or if you have a history of hives or acute rhinitis caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or if the user is a child. Do not use it on damaged skin or mucous membranes, or on areas with eczema or rash. Itching, redness, flushing, dermatitis (rash, eczema), or contact dermatitis may occur occasionally, and irritation or blisters rarely. If these symptoms are severe, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
